reason: I'd actually download this because honest ranges and a summary for my doctor sound better than Flo guessing wrong every month, but the first summary and the logging are free, so I'd just use that. On $19k I'm not paying for Pro until the free version proves it understands my cycles.
objection: Every app says its predictions work for irregular cycles and they never do, so I don't trust it'll be any different until I've used it for a few months. And I only see my doctor a couple of times a year, so paying monthly feels pointless.
would_change_my_mind: If the free summary actually showed my doctor whether metformin or inositol is doing anything, I'd pay the $7.99 before my next appointment.
